name: The splintered paths of Emor
description: An experiment going wrong sent a young apprentice to a strange crossroad
author: Custom Creator

node_apprentice_workshop_experiment.title: The experiment
node_apprentice_workshop_experiment.content: Was it a lapse in concentration, hubris or tapping into forbidden knowledged? No, it was misplaced trust. Sometimes all it takes to create a catastrophy is a successful attempt to hide ones failure. Replacing a spilled ingredient with another in the hope the master doesn't notice led to the fabric of reality being torn apart. Before the master could close the rift, the apprentice paid for his failure.

node_emor_arrival_strange_place.title: A strange place
node_emor_arrival_strange_place.content: What happened? I... I should have... am I... where am I? What is this place?

node_emor_arrival_guiding_voice.title: The Emor
node_emor_arrival_guiding_voice.content: This is the Emor. The place all paths splinter from into the domains of the universe. Why did you enter Emor, summoner?

node_emor_arrival_apprentice.title: Summoner
node_emor_arrival_apprentice.content: Emor? Summoner? I am hardly a summoner. I am just an apprentice. I have to return to my master, ask for forgivness and make amends.

node_emor_paths_explanation.title: Paths of emor
node_emor_paths_explanation.content:
A simple apprentice? Hmm. Well, here is some knowledge you might not have sought, but you will need.

As I said, you are in Emor, where all paths splinter from. There are untold paths leading towards one domain or another but dangers lurks on all of them. These dangers were created from the imagination of those who wield and twist mana to create and summon everything from mundane creatures to outright horrors. Eventually this mana returns here but often still tainted with by the realm it was summoned to. This creates the creatures haunting the paths of Emor.

node_emor_mana_explanation.title: Mana
node_emor_mana_explanation.content:
While your native realm limits the amount of mana spent in a summoning, here you can freely use all the mana you possess to summon creatures. But beware, once the creature you summoned is defeated the mana will be freed from your control. However, you can harness the mana of the creatures you defeat.

Emor will restore a limited amount of mana everytime you enter, but if you want more you will have to fight for it.

node_emor_mana_apprentice_question.title: The fight for mana
node_emor_mana_apprentice_question.content:
I think I understand, so mana is a currency in this realm, the more I have the more powerful creatures I can summon, but I shouldn't use more mana than I can harness from the creatures I defeat.

There is just one problem, I have no mana.

node_emor_mana_spring_directions.title: There is a mana spring
node_emor_mana_spring_directions.content: There is a mana spring nearby. It is just a small spring, but it will provide you with enough mana to start on one of the many paths. It is right over there. Go there and let the mana flow into you.

node_emor_mana_spring_discovery.title: Discovering the mana spring
node_emor_mana_spring_discovery.content: You walk towards the small spring where mana spills into the realm. As you touch the flow of mana it trickles into you. You have received 10 mana.

node_emor_departure_preparation.title: About to set out
node_emor_departure_preparation.content: Very well, this should suffice to go on a first path. I trust you know of some summons. Use them, but don't go out to deep. In fact, would you pick up a pebble from the ground?

node_emor_homecoming_pebble.title: The homecoming pebble
node_emor_homecoming_pebble.content:
This pebble will bring you right back to the spot where you picked it up. At the cost of all your mana, but better to lose your mana than your life. There is always the spring to replenish you, but resurrection only works on summons.

Now go, one of many paths await.

node_emor_first_path_departure.title: The first path
node_emor_first_path_departure.content:
Looking around for a path you notice that you are surrounded by sheer nothingness. Armed with a tiny bit of mana, a pebble and the memory of a few summons you walk out in a random direction. You notice how the nothing around you forms into a landscape, every step creating a clearer picture of where you are going. It seems to be some sort of backalley.

Suddenly, the nothing in front of you forms into 2 strange critters. Not taking any chances you start summoning.

node_first_path_critter_battle.title: The first battle
node_first_path_critter_battle.description: Two strange critters are about to pounce at you.

node_first_path_critter_battle_defeat.title: Defeated by critters
node_first_path_critter_battle_defeat.content: Your summons have been defeated and a critter is pouncing you. You react quickly and activate the homecoming pebble. The next instance you find yourself back in Emor. Determined to do better you visit the mana spring and go back out. Soon you face the critters again.

node_first_path_critter_battle_victory.title: First battle won
node_first_path_critter_battle_victory.content:
You won your first battle, hopefully the first of many. Note, that you recuperated all the mana from your surviving summons and you got half of the mana of the defeated enemies. It is possible to build quite some mana by defeating enemies.

Another thing. Now that you freed the mana of its tainted form you collected the essence of the imagination, the energies that forced the mana into the creature you just defeated. This essence is quite valuable in this realm, as it can be used create from the raw mana, similar to how you create your summons, but on a much wider scale.

Go ahead, follow your path. Retrieve mana, collect essence.

node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_rabbit_ba.title: Rabbit rumble
node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_rabbit_ba.description: You come across a small meadow with rabbits jumping around. Some seem rather aggressive.

node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_croaking_.title: Croaking pond
node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_croaking_.description: Your path leads you to a small pond. You hear loud croaking as you catch a terrible foul smelling whif. Then you see the toads approach.

node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_critter_b.title: Critter attack
node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_critter_b.description: You spot these strange critters again behind a bush. They turns towards you and charge.

node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_swarming_.title: Swarming lights
node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_swarming_.description: You pass a large tree when you suddenly see more and more lights swarming towards you.

node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_rabbit_ba.title: Beaten by bunnies
node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_rabbit_ba.content: Beaten. By. Bunnies. Your summoned creatures were beaten by... bunnies. Well, time to activate the pebble.

node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_croaking_.title: The croak of death
node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_croaking_.content: The toads overwhelm your forces. Not wanting to find out what they would do to you, you activate the pebble.

node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_critter_b.title: Defeated by critters
node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_critter_b.content: The critter rip your summons appart and charge you just as you activate the pebble.

node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_swarming_.title: Stinged by the swarm
node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_swarming_.content: The swarming fireflies burn your forces to cinders. You feel the heat just as you activate the pebble.

node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_soft_eart.title: Worm food
node_tranquil_meadow_outskirts_soft_eart.content: The worms drag your forces to the ground. You quickly activate the pebble as more worms show up.

node_emor_homecoming_pebble_return.title: Return to Emor
node_emor_homecoming_pebble_return.content: You activate the homecoming pebble and find yourself back in Emor.

node_emor_hub.title: Emor
node_emor_hub.prompt: Emor, where all paths of the realm originate from.

choices.description: An artist has set up on the outskirts of Emor, staring down a path, waiting for inspiration.
Describe this point of interest.
Describe this point of interest.
A strange crystal is rising from the ground in the center of Emor.
Describe this point of interest.

node_emor_tranquil_meadow_departure.title: A new path
node_emor_tranquil_meadow_departure.content: You visit the mana spring and set out on another path.

node_first_path_creature_parts.title: Creature parts
node_first_path_creature_parts.content: Another battle won and look, the tainted mana materialized into creature parts. This happens when the mana can't free itself, not even when the creature is destroyed. There is an artist in Emor, he could be interested in these things, you should visit him.

node_emor_artist_shop.title: The artist
node_emor_artist_shop.description: An artist has set up on the outskirts of Emor, staring down a path, waiting for inspiration.

node_first_path_rabbit_battle_defeat.title: Defeated by rabbits
node_first_path_rabbit_battle_defeat.content: The rabbits rush around, biting and darting. As the last of your summons fall you activate the pebble.

node_tranquil_meadow_crossroads.title: Tranquil meadow
node_tranquil_meadow_crossroads.prompt: You find yourself in a tranquil meadow which stretches ahead of you. To your left you see the beginning of a forest, to your right the plains give way to hills.

choices.description: You continue on the meadow, walking through high grass and flowers.
You turn towards the forest and soon the meadow gives way to trees and brambles.

choices.text: Go to the direction of the hills
choices.description: You make your way towards the hills, spotting rocks along the way.

node_tranquil_meadow_unfinished_path.title: Not yet designed
node_tranquil_meadow_unfinished_path.content: Yeah, this is not yet designed. Tell you what, lets just say you ended up in a tranquil meadow.

node_tranquil_meadow_interior_flower.title: Pretty flower
node_tranquil_meadow_interior_flower.prompt: You come across a particulary pretty flower.

choices.description: Description of the first path
You take in the sight a moment longer and continue.

node_tranquil_meadow_interior_flower_ben.title: Good flower
node_tranquil_meadow_interior_flower_ben.content: You pick the flower and its blossoms start to glow. The mana stored in the flower flows to you.

node_tranquil_meadow_interior_flower_har.title: Bad flower
node_tranquil_meadow_interior_flower_har.content: As you pick the flower you feels a bit woozy. Too late you realize the toxic spores poisoning you. You quickly drop the flower and cast a minor healing spell.

node_tranquil_meadow_interior_molerat_ba.title: Defeated by a molerat
node_tranquil_meadow_interior_molerat_ba.content: Not too happy with the lack of nutrition provided by your summons the molerat turns to you. Pebble time.

node_tranquil_meadow_abandoned_farm_appr.title: A farm in the distance
node_tranquil_meadow_abandoned_farm_appr.prompt: Walking through the meadow for some time you come across an overgrown field and shortly after you spot a couple of buildings in the distance.

choices.description: You approach the farm. It seems quiet, looks abandoned
You decide to change direction and walk back into the meadow.

node_abandoned_farm_arrival.title: Abandoned (?) farm
node_abandoned_farm_arrival.content: You walk towards the farm and make yourself known, but nobody answers. There are a couple builldings. A large building which looks like the main house is off the to left, a barn is straight ahead and a what looks to be a chicken coop is next to it. To the right you see a stable with a big much heap next to it. In the center of the farm you see a well that has been boarded up.

node_abandoned_farm_hub.title: Abandoned farm
node_abandoned_farm_hub.prompt: Where would you like to go?

choices.description: You approach the main house and try the door.
You walk towards the barn and open the heavy door.
You find the eggs collector behind the barn with his personal guard.
You walk towards the chicken coop.
The stable is run down. The other animals are gone, and the pigs have taken over.
The doghouse door is barricaded, but a tunnel has been dug beneath it toward the nearby forest.
The old farm dog has made the small lumber camp his exile home.

node_text_the_stable.title: The stable
node_text_the_stable.content: You approach the stable and hear grunting, quieking and snorting. You risk a quick peak through the door when one of the pigs notices you. The excited pig mob storms towards you with torches and pitchforks. Having no doubt in your mind that you can't fight them off you resort to use the pebble.

node_abandoned_farm_doghouse.title: The Doghouse
node_abandoned_farm_doghouse.content: The doghouse door has been barricaded from the outside. Beneath it, a narrow tunnel has been dug toward the nearby forest.

node_abandoned_farm_well.title: The Boarded-up Well
node_abandoned_farm_well.content: The well stands in the center of the farm, its opening sealed beneath heavy boards.

node_abandoned_farm_main_house_pig_butch.title: Defeated by the pig butcher
node_abandoned_farm_main_house_pig_butch.content: The furious assault by the pig butcher leads you to stagger backwards out of the house. You activate the pebble just as the pig swings its cleaver. That was close.

node_abandoned_farm_main_house_master_be.title: The master bedroom door
node_abandoned_farm_main_house_master_be.content: Having defeated the pig butcher you collect some of the meat on the table and move deeper into the house. As you approach what you think must be the master bedroom you notice a bad smell.

node_abandoned_farm_main_house_den_of_gl.title: The den of gluttony
node_abandoned_farm_main_house_den_of_gl.content: As you open the door and peek through you see an incredibly fat pig lying in a large double bed, surrounded by smaller pig servants catering to it. You don't know whether it is the sight or the smell that makes you gag more. The pig was clearly expecting its next meal, but seeing as you killed the cook, you will have to do.

node_abandoned_farm_main_house_god_of_po.title: The god of pork
node_abandoned_farm_main_house_god_of_po.description: The incredibly fat pig squeels orders at his servants who attack you.

node_abandoned_farm_main_house_empty.title: The empty main house
node_abandoned_farm_main_house_empty.content: The main house is empty, but the stench remains and will for a long time.

node_abandoned_farm_main_house_god_of_po.title: Defeated by the god pork
node_abandoned_farm_main_house_god_of_po.content: With your summons gone and the eye watering stench seemingly getting worse you welcome the escape of the pebble.

node_abandoned_farm_main_house_god_of_po.title: The end of the divine pork
node_abandoned_farm_main_house_god_of_po.content: As the massive form of the god of pork collapses it release a large amount of mana. Just as you try to capture the energies they turn into the familiar looking form of card. You pick it up and inspect it. The card depicts the god of pork and the knowledge of how to summon it reveals itself to you. As the card disintegrates in your hand the faint smell of lard fills the air.

node_abandoned_farm_barn_interior.title: Inside the barn
node_abandoned_farm_barn_interior.content: Inside the barn you find all sorts of stored harvest. Potatoes, grain, carrots, all kind of vegetables. Some of the food seems edible, some is already rotting away. You hear gorging sounds from behind the barn door and see a large pig. Standing on four legs, happily grunting away it looks more like an ordinary pig. The scene stops being ordinary when the pig turns towards you, growls and fletches its teeth.

node_abandoned_farm_barn_guard_hog_battl.title: Defeated by the guard hog
node_abandoned_farm_barn_guard_hog_battl.content: The hog mauls your summons and snarls at you as if he wants to give you one last chance to run. You get the hint and use the pebble.

node_abandoned_farm_barn_guard_hog_battl.title: Defeated the guard hog
node_abandoned_farm_barn_guard_hog_battl.content: As the guard hog fades a small object stays behind, a key. You pocket the key.

node_abandoned_farm_barn_abandoned_harve.title: The abandoned harvest
node_abandoned_farm_barn_abandoned_harve.content: The barn is full of stored harvest, some of it already rotten. There is nothing for you to do here.

node_abandoned_farm_main_house_locked_do.title: Main house door
node_abandoned_farm_main_house_locked_do.content: The door to the main house it locked. You try to force it open but it won't budge.

node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_interio.title: Enter the chicken coop
node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_interio.content: You open the door to the chicken coop and see dozen chickens sitting in their nests, looking distressed. The biggest one turns to you and to your surprise starts to talk.

node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_mother_.title: Meeting mother cluck
node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_mother_.content:
You stupid pigs already took our eggs today, leave us alone.

She looks you up and down for a moment.

Wait, you are no pig. You are a human!

node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_plight.title: The chickens plight
node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_plight.content:
Are you... are you... are you take the farm back from the pigs? Please, you have to free us from these gluttonous beasts. They ate so many of us before realizing that no chickens means no eggs. Stupid pigs. And now we can't keep up with laying enough eggs and they know it. One of the pigs, we only know him as the eggs collector, keeps coming to the coop, grunting "eggs collector". He then gleefully throws us around and takes the eggs. We would give them to him anyway, but he just enjoys feels like a big guy when he collects the eggs for the tyrants.

Kill him and we will reward you. When he isn't taking our eggs he usually rolls around in the mud behind the barn.

node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_return.title: Return to the chicken coop
node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_return.content: With the eggs collector defeated you return to Mother cluck to bring the news.

node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_sleepin.title: Sleeping chickens
node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_sleepin.content: You return to the chicken coop, but all the chicken are asleep. Or maybe they are just pretending to be.

node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_liberat.title: Chicken liberator
node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_liberat.content:
That is his sack. You really did it? You killed the eggs collector? Our hero!

About that reward. Here, take this egg.

node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_unusual.title: A not so simple egg
node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_unusual.content: You take the egg and it immediately starts to crack. You expect to see a little chick, instead mana flows out of the egg shaping into a card. The card seems to depict a chicken.

node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_eggbert.title: Eggbert the eternal
node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_eggbert.content:
This is the symbol of chicken hope. Eggbert the eternal, protector of all that is chicken. We didn't have the means to summon him, but you... you can. He will fight your enemies for as long as you live.

Now go, defeat the pigs in the main house and free us of these monsters once and for all.

node_abandoned_farm_egg_collector_battle.title: Eggs collector
node_abandoned_farm_egg_collector_battle.description: The eggs collector is rolling around in mud and notices you too late to flee to the main house. This is your chance to kill him.

node_abandoned_farm_egg_collector_battle.title: Defeated by the eggs collector
node_abandoned_farm_egg_collector_battle.content: Your summoned forces succumb to the savy pig bureaucrat and you are force to flee to avoid paying a tax in your own blood. You activate the pebble, but as you arrive back you notice some imagination has been taken.

node_abandoned_farm_egg_collector_battle.title: End of the eggs collector
node_abandoned_farm_egg_collector_battle.content: As the broken body of the eggs collector fades away you notice his sack, crusted with the yolk of broken eggs. You decide to bring it back to the chickens as proof of the monsters demise.

node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_happy_c.title: Happy chickens
node_abandoned_farm_chicken_coop_happy_c.content: The chickens are enthusiastically clucking, happy that their tormentor is no more.

node_emor_trader_shop.title: The trader
node_emor_trader_shop.description: The hooded figure of the trader stands behind a strange black table.

node_emor_trader_arrival.title: Arrival of the trader
node_emor_trader_arrival.content: You notice a hooded figure arrive at Emor. Not used to anyone arriving in Emor you curiously watch as the hooded figure sets up what looks like a market stall with a strange dark table as its centerpiece. As soon as the creature is finished it beckons you to approach.

node_emor_trader_gathering.title: The trader arrived
node_emor_trader_gathering.content: A trader arrived in Emor. They travel the realms and buy and sell. Nobody knows whether they are after profit or just revel in the trading itself, but they seem to have endless coffers. You will be able to buy and sell certain objects you find along the paths of Emor

node_emor_trader_introduction.title: Meeting the trader
node_emor_trader_introduction.content: Welcome traveller of the paths. I am looking for the spoils of this realm. I will take any you don't need off your hands. Do you by chance have anything for me?

node_emor_architect_rising_crystal.title: The rising crystal
node_emor_architect_rising_crystal.content: A strange, rose-colored crystal keeps rising from the ground, it's edges seem to reflect light that isn't there.

node_emor_architect_unlock.title: The architect unlocked
node_emor_architect_unlock.content: The architect arrived. Some say this entity is the creator of Emor, others says he merely found and shaped it. Be that as it may, he seems to have run out of inspiration of what Emor could be. Maybe some imagination can help him to improve Emor.

node_emor_architect_shop.title: The architect
node_emor_architect_shop.description: The architect looks like an inert crystal, but you feel a presence, hungering inside.

node_the_pig_stable.title: The pig stable
node_the_pig_stable.content: Well aware that there are likely dozens of pigs inside you steer clear of the stable.

node_text_collapsing_the_stable.title: Collapsing the stable
node_text_collapsing_the_stable.content: According to the dogs plan you use your mana to summon a weak earthquake. The stable quickly starts collapsing, burying most of the pigs under the rubble. A small group of pigs escaped and with your mana drained from the spell all you can do is resort to the pebble. Just as you activate it you see the dog with a torch in its mouth.

node_text_smoking_ruins_of_the_stable.title: Smoking ruins of the stable
node_text_smoking_ruins_of_the_stable.content: After you made your way back to the farm you come across the smoking ruins of the stable. You approach as the smell of bacon enters your nose. Suddenly you hear squeaking noises. You turn to see a few scarred and burned pigs attack.

node_battle_the_burn_scarred_pigs.title: The burn-scarred pigs
node_battle_the_burn_scarred_pigs.description: A group of pigs which survived the collapse and burning of the stable is out for revenge.

node_text_defeated_by_burn_scarred_pigs.title: Defeated by burn-scarred pigs
node_text_defeated_by_burn_scarred_pigs.content: It must be the distracting smell of bacon which allows the pigs to overwhelm your forces. You use the pebble to escape, but can you escape the hankering for bacon?

node_text_reunited_with_the_farm_dog.title: Reunited with the farm dog
node_text_reunited_with_the_farm_dog.content: Shortly after you took down the burn-scarred pigs the farm dog approaches you, his mouth bloodied.

node_text_vengeance_completed.title: Vengeance completed
node_text_vengeance_completed.content: That must have been the last of them. Finally the master has been avenged. But... what now. I thought I would feel relief, but all I feel is emptiness where before was purpose. I... I...

node_text_those_out_for_revenge.title: Those out for revenge
node_text_those_out_for_revenge.content: The dog saddens and walks towards the well where he start to dig in what you can only describe as a melancholic way.

node_text_the_small_forest.title: The small forest
node_text_the_small_forest.content: You walk towards the small forest the tunnel seems to have led to. As you approach the ouskirts full of overgrowth you spot a small storage for logs and a rusted old axe. When you take a closer look you hear a growl. You fear a wolf, but as you turn you see an old dog with a missing eye approach. To your surprise it talks.

node_text_the_snarling_dog.title: The snarling dog
node_text_the_snarling_dog.content: It was your last mistake to come out here you damn pig.

choices.description: You frantically look through your belongings in search for something to appease the dog.
You attempt to pet the dog.
You start to slowly back away.
You start summoning.

node_text_feeding_the_dog.title: Feeding the dog
node_text_feeding_the_dog.content: You throw the chunk of molerat meat to the dog who eyes the meat. Then eyes you, seemingly squinting.

node_text_pigs_don_t_share.title: Pigs don't share
node_text_pigs_don_t_share.content: Pigs don't share food. You are no pig. You are a... can it be... you are a human?!

node_text_a_dog_s_tale.title: A dog's tale
node_text_a_dog_s_tale.content:
Apologies for my rudeness. My sight is bad since... that night...

Since you are human, maybe you are here to restore the farm. You see, a long time ago, the farm was very different. It was the era of the humans. I was just a pup when the master brought me here and for years I served him diligently. It was a good time, the master and his wife took care of the farm and all animals were cared for. Everyone was happy, even the damned pigs.

node_text_a_dog_s_tale_continues.title: A dog's tale continues
node_text_a_dog_s_tale_continues.content:
Then something happened. The master didn't leave his house for days. I waited faithfully at the door when he eventually came out of the house but all he did was grab a shovel and dug a large whole. Then he put his wife inside and close it and just sat there in the dirt for hours.

That is when I failed him. I wanted to be there for him and I didn't notice the unrest that plagued the other animals. Many hadn't be fed for days, the horses and the ox had escaped and the pigs had broken into the barn. I thought they were just stealing the masters food, but when he got up to get water from the well, the pigs stored out pushed him in. That was the last time I saw the master and the last time I heard his voice as he screamed, falling into the well.

node_text_a_dog_s_tale_ends.title: A dog's tale ends
node_text_a_dog_s_tale_ends.content:
In a rage I attacked the pigs, ripping and tearing through flesh and bone, but there were too many of them. They overwhelmed me, sat on me laughing and grunting. They would have killed me then but a terrible storm saved me.

The pigs sheltered in the stable and the main house and I dragged myself into the doghouse and collapsed. When I woke up, the doghouse was barricaded. The stupid pigs thought would leave me there to starve. Instead I dug out and escaped to this small camp, the only other place I knew. From here I have been planning my revenge, tearing apart every pig that strays too far. Eventually I will kill them all and avenge the master.

node_text_the_farm_dog_s_plan.title: The farm dog's plan
node_text_the_farm_dog_s_plan.content: Listen human. Most of the pigs made their home in the stable. The master had plans to build another one, he kept saying that it could collapse in a storm. All we need is a proper storm and the stupid pigs will shelter in the stable and it will collapse on them. Every storm I hope it will happen, but as much as the stable's walls groan it is never quite enough. Maybe you can find something that helps you in this camp.

node_decision_looking_through_the_small_.title: Looking through the small lumber camp
node_decision_looking_through_the_small_.prompt: The camp is just a small tent, inside is a small trunk, some rope and a small straw mat.

choices.description: You walk over to small trunk and check what is inside.
You pick up the rope to have a closer look.
You sit down on the mat to rest for a moment when you discover a small leather bundle under it.

node_text_the_axes_won_t_help.title: The axes won't help
node_text_the_axes_won_t_help.content: You find it filled with a couple large and small axes. While they were kept dry for the most part they are clearly worn. Even if they were in pristine condition, you doubt you could collapse the stables with them.

node_text_the_rope_won_t_help.title: The rope won't help
node_text_the_rope_won_t_help.content: The rope was probably used to drag chopped trees into the camp and is a bit worn but looks fine. You doubt you have the upper body strength to pull down the stable though.

node_text_the_small_leather_bundle.title: The small leather bundle
node_text_the_small_leather_bundle.content:
You open up the leather bundle to find a book inside. It looks old but strangely well preserved considering it must have been lying here for a long time. You open it up and find the title.

Of storms and stables - by Alric Stormbringer

You remember your former mentor talking about this Alric before. He was a powerful mage.

Curious you start reading the book. To your surprise it is not a collection of spells and arcane magic, but Alric ranting on and on about how he really hated living next to a farm. In the appendix you find instructions for the spell he used to... solve his issue.

You study the spell and think you can reproduce it, but it will require large amounts of mana.

You wonder whether the forest holds some beasts that can supply the mana you need.

node_decision_berry_bush.title: Berry bush
node_decision_berry_bush.prompt: You find some tasty looking berries. Do you want to eat them?

choices.description: You taste the berries.
You ignore the berries and are on your way.
Knowing how dangerous berry bushes can be you summon your forces.

node_text_pet_the_snarling_dog.title: Pet the snarling dog
node_text_pet_the_snarling_dog.content: The dog snaps at your hand. You quickly pull back and realize it may not have been the best idea to try to pet a strange, aggressive, talking dog.

node_text_flee_from_the_dog.title: Flee from the dog
node_text_flee_from_the_dog.content: As you back away slowly in the direction of the farm the dog follows you. Just when you think it is time to use the pebble it turns and walks back to the lumber camp.

node_text_getting_pounced.title: Getting pounced
node_text_getting_pounced.content: Before even your first summon is complete the dog pounces at you and pushes you to the ground. Just in time to avoid the dog's bite you manage to activate the pebble, but as you arrive in Emor you can still feel the teeth on your skin. That was close.

node_text_tasty_berries.title: Tasty berries
node_text_tasty_berries.content: The berries taste sweet and delicious. You have a few more before you continue your search.

node_text_tasty_berries_but.title: Tasty berries, but...
node_text_tasty_berries_but.content: You taste a berry and is tastes a bit bittersweet. You have another, and another, and... then you realize your stomach rumbling. Luckily you are surrounded by bushes. You quickly conjure up some toilet paper and do what needs to be done.

node_text_berry_ambush.title: Berry ambush
node_text_berry_ambush.content: Just as you grab one of the berries the bush comes to life and thrashes at you with its thorns. You quickly summon your forces in defense.

node_text_defenseless_berry_bush.title: Defenseless berry bush
node_text_defenseless_berry_bush.content: Your summons make short work of a poor defenseless berry bush who only wanted to make the world a better place by providing sweet and healthy nutrition to all. You monster.

node_text_battle_of_the_berries.title: Battle of the berries
node_text_battle_of_the_berries.content: Sensing your intent the berry bushes awake, more than you had expected start to pepper your forces with thorns.

node_text_retreat_from_the_berry_bushes.title: Retreat from the berry bushes
node_text_retreat_from_the_berry_bushes.content: As your summons have fallen and you are about to feel the sting of hundreds of thorns you activate the pebble.

node_text_berry_bush_purge.title: Berry bush purge
node_text_berry_bush_purge.content: Your summons defeated the dangerous berry bushes and made the forest a bit safer.  You collect a few trophies and are on your way.

node_text_survived_the_berry_ambush.title: Survived the berry ambush
node_text_survived_the_berry_ambush.content: Having defeated the berry bush... ambush... you pocket berry you picked and continue into the forest.

node_decision_clearing.title: Clearing
node_decision_clearing.prompt: Walking through the forest you realize its size was deceptive and it is large enough to get lost. Finally the thicket lightens and you see a path out of it, leading to the abandoned farm. You could have sworn it must be in the other direction.

choices.description: You leave the forest and return to the abandoned farm.
Not wanting to return to the farm you go back into the forest.
